name: unsloth
summary: Per GitHub issue #8900, loading a model with from_pretrained() makes a default-on usage-count request: it downloads a bucketed file from a Hugging Face repo, reflecting environment type, VRAM and GPU-count buckets. Hugging Face receives the request metadata. The official docs say Unsloth collects no usage telemetry beyond minimal hardware information, which the issue disputes.

optOut.instructions: Set the environment variable UNSLOTH_DISABLE_STATISTICS before running or importing unsloth. Setting HF_HUB_OFFLINE or TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE also stops it, per the issue's reading of the source. I did not confirm the accepted value for UNSLOTH_DISABLE_STATISTICS, so 1 is an assumption.
